Name: Metalboom
Description:
You touch a metallic orb to infuse it with entropic energy and turn it into a grenade. As part of casting this spell you toss it to a point within reach, forcing all targets within reach to pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer 3d6 bludgeoning damage and 2 Tremor, or half on a success.

When you toss the orb you may also choose to have it inflict Tremor Burst after all other effects have resolved.
At Higher Levels: For each 2 spell slot levels spent above 2nd, the damage of this spell increases by 2d6 and it inflicts an additional Tremor.
